notes.title: Dev Blog #86 - The Big Christmas Update is Here!
notes.notes:
Ho, Ho, Ho! Merry Christmas!

The big Christmas Update is here! We are super excited to present a new private space with different furniture customisation options, Christmas costumes & bodysuits, facial hair for men, New Winter Forest space as subscribers' preview.
[h1]New Build 0.12.0.4150 is now live![/h1]
* New facial hair for men
* New video screens in Crowbots
* Lighting for Crowbots have been fixed.
* Aurora Orbs colour fixes
* 4 new items added to existing DLCs
* New futuristic furniture available in Mirage House
* Blocking issues fixes
[h1]LakeView Retreat[/h1]
New space "LAKEVIEW RETREAT" is now live! It is a beautiful hideaway designed by SubD Studio. The space offers Classic & Rustic furniture customisation options. We have also added Christmas and Birthday decorations which can be turned on & off.
[h1]Winter Forest[/h1]
Winter Forest is in "work in progress" stage, and is available to our Premier Subscribers as a preview. We will be adding more features to it in the future, so keep an eye out!
[h1]Christmas Costumes[/h1]
Celebrate this holiday season in style with new Mother Christmas & Santa Claus Costumes.
[h1]Merry Christmas T-shirts[/h1]
Animated "Merry Christmas" shirts are now available for Adam and Eve!
[h1]Advent Calendar[/h1]
Advent Calendar has unlocked 7 items!
But there are still 17 more Surprise Gifts to be discovered!
Look for the Christmas Star in the Accessories Tab.

We hope you are looking forward to Christmas and see you next week!

notes.title: Dev blog #75 - 0.10.0.4150 New Patch! Plus celebrate our birthday with sales, gifts, parties and more!
notes.notes:
Wonderful news, Atomians! Our latest patch is here, and our 1st birthday has arrived!

We can finally share with you all the exciting things we have planned to celebrate this marvellous milestone. Plus we have a new public space; oodles of new items; super sales; generous gifts; a slick new tutorial; and even more exciting, we have brought molecules to the PC version, so now it is possible to buy items when you play on PC!

We have been so busy working on all this new content and we are delighted to share it with you, so come on... let's party!
[h1]Happy Birthday to *us*![/h1]
Just 1 more sleep until our birthday! There's so much awesome birthday stuff I'm going to have to break it down, otherwise you'll miss bits!
[h1]Mirage House Pool Party and awesome new birthday items[/h1]
[img]http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/Pool-Party.jpg[/img]

We've chosen Saturday as our 'official' birthday, but we are starting the celebrations right away with birthday themed clothing and decorations. Host your own birthday pool party in Mirage House, hang up the bunting and balloons and don't forget a giant pile of presents!

[img]http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/Tshirts-and-hat-copy.jpg[/img]

Grab one of our birthday t-shirts to show you are in the party mood. These shirts also double up for when it is your birthday, so you can let everyone know that you are a year older :D (Luckily Adam and Eve don't ever age so no one will really know!)

Put on your free cake hat, delicious! (I told you there would be cake!)

 
[h1]Sale On![/h1]
[img]http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/Sale.jpg[/img]

This weekend just keeps getting better! On Saturday and Sunday to celebrate our birthday we are holding a sale on all items! That's right, everything in the game that you buy with molecules will have an amazing 50% off for this weekend only! Subscribers will get their usual 10% off as well, so this really could be the 'sale of the century'!!!

Don't miss out, make sure you visit us this weekend to take advantage of this amazing offer. Take the chance to treat yourself to that highly desirable item you've had your eye on for a while - you deserve it ;)

 
[h1]Happy birthday to *you*![/h1]
[img]http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/gifts-copy.jpg[/img]

It's not just *our* 1 year anniversary, some of you have been with us for that long (and even longer) too! So we wanted to say thank you by gifting you some awesome gifts when you reach your 3 month, 6 month and 1 year anniversaries!

The day you reach your anniversary you will receive the appropriate reward plus the bonus subscription. If you have already passed two or more of the anniversaries then you will get each of the items, and the longest bonus subscription (the subscriptions will not add up, sorry!). If you already have a subscription, the bonus subscription will kick in once your current subscription has ended.
[list]
	[*]3 months - Iridescent baseball cap and 7 day bonus subscription[/*]
	[*]6 months - Glowing sole trainers and 14 day bonus subscription[/*]
	[*]12 months - Animated fireworks t-shirt and 30 day bonus subscription[/*]
[/list]
Check out the User Profile in the settings tab of the main menu to find out when you joined us and start planning for your anniversary!

 
[h1]Fondest memory competition[/h1]
[img]http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/best-memories-contest-copy.jpg[/img]

We want to say thank you to all of you who have wished us a happy birthday so far or who have taken part in the competition to share your greatest AU memories. This competition is now closed, now we are going to enjoy reading them all and choosing a winner!

 

[img]http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/Happy-birthday-copy.jpg[/img]
[h1]Party, Party, Party...[/h1]
If you didn't have a memory to share yet, how about creating a new one? Something really special will happen at 8PM today UK time to our latest public space (more details below), so make sure you don't miss it.

For the whole week we will be hosting a massive party in this space and while you are at the party you can take part in our new photo competition! We want to see your awesome photos from the party. So get your best party outfit on, invite your crew and pose! Find out how to enter on our [url=https://www.facebook.com/AtomRepublic/photos/a.370246169730963.91226.362572827164964/1445983862157183/?type=3]Facebook page[/url].

 

 
[h1]Our new public space...? It's Crowbots!!![/h1]
[img]http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/WelcomeScreen_Crowbots.png[/img]

Crowbots has returned! We have had many requests asking about it and wondering if it would ever come back, so that's what we have done! Crowbots was around in the early days, but if you don't know it, it's a new nightclub with a darker vibe than Arcade Plaza, plus we've added some really interesting interactions with the environment...
I'll let you guys figure them out, but they're super cool!

You can get to it from the spaces tab, or through the door in The Hub, so head over to Crowbots for an edgier experience; chat, dance, glow and have fun in the darkness!

Our mega BIRTHDAY PARTY will take place in here on today at 8PM UK time, until the same time next Saturday, and something very special will happen to the space during that time. Remember we said there might be cake? Well look out for a giant cake! Dance around it... or maybe you will find a way to interact with it ;) There's also a huge slice on the bar for you all to share.

Make sure you join us for the party or in the week following it, as Crowbots will return to normal on Friday 29th September and you will miss the cake!

 
[h1]Molecules for all![/h1]
[img]http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/Molecules-on-Steam-copy.jpg[/img]

Another highly requested feature is to enable molecules on the PC version so that PC users can buy items in the game. We've been working on this and we can now announce that it's here!

Top up your steam wallet and then click on an item that is available for purchase. You will be prompted to add Molecules to your AU account, and then you will be able to purchase anything in the game that requires you to spend molecules.

Think about freshening up your outfit with a snazzy new clothing item or accessory; travelling to distant lands like Aurora Private Islands or Cave House; arranging furniture in your Urban Apartment or Mirage House; or getting your hair cut into one of our awesome gradient designs.

As well as molecules you can now purchase the Christmas, Halloween, Medieval and Japanese DLC packs through Steam; and you can also purchase a subscription!

Having access to molecules unlocks your AU experience and gives you so much more! Have fun exploring your extra options!

 
[h1]Let us guide you![/h1]
[img]http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/Atom-Universe_20170920161739.jpg[/img]

New users will be treated to a tour of some of the key features and spaces in Atom Universe when they first log in. Instead of going to the main menu, a new user will be whisked straight to their Urban Apartment to begin their AU adventure. We want new users to feel more at home when they first arrive, and we hope the tutorial will help them do that. But don't forget, new peeps still need your friendly guidance!

The tutorial will also play for existing users the first time they log in after the patch if they have not verified their email address with us. You only have to play the tutorial once, and all users can replay the tutorial at any time, by clicking on the 'Start Tutorial' button in the Settings tab of the main menu.

 
[h1]Improved Reporting[/h1]
We have added an extra step to reporting so that you can let us know more about why you reported someone. Select Report from the social menu as normal, then choose a reason from the drop down and if you want to, you can type into the box below to give more details.

This will help us to moderate undesirable users and make Atom Universe an even better place to be!

 
[h1]Other Bits[/h1]
[list]
	[*]Orb Runner will now cost 10A to play. We hope you enjoyed the free period, but to bring Orb Runner in line with our other games it's time to charge Atoms for it.
Don't forget, Atoms are free and you get more each day you log in. If you log in each day in a row, you get even more Atoms, and subscribers get even more still! If you are getting low, you can take a chance and put it all on Holo-Horses and hope you win big :)[/*]
	[*]Flags will now flutter in Aurora Private Islands[/*]
[/list]
 

 

Goodness me! That's one bumper patch all right :)
Get ready for it to drop at 9AM UK time today and be first to explore the new spaces, items and features :)

See you by the giant cake!
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
	[*]Fixed a bug where sometimes Atoms weren't taken when you played games[/*]
	[*]Fixed a bug where you couldn't change your clothing if you changed genders through the in-game player menu[/*]
	[*]Fixed a bug where the invisi-blocking aspect of blocking wasn't always working properly[/*]
[/list]

	[*]Flags will now flutter in Aurora Private Islands[/*]

Goodness me! That's one bumper patch all right :)
Get ready for it to drop at 9AM UK time today and be first to explore the new spaces, items and features :)

See you by the giant cake!
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
	[*]Fixed a bug where sometimes Atoms weren't taken when you played games[/*]
	[*]Fixed a bug where you couldn't change your clothing if you changed genders through the in-game player menu[/*]

notes.notes:

IT'S UPDATE TIME!

Version 0.9.0.4150 will be released today at 1:30pm (UK time) and it contains all this lovely lovely stuff! 

Remember I told you something exciting was coming? Well get ready, there's lots to read...



[h1]Right here, right now![/h1]

https://www.youtube.com/embed/tQPn-QfiEPg


We are so overwhelmingly excited to tell you all about this new improvement. It is now possible to change your outfit and buy new items without having to leave the space you are in! That's right, the menu to do this is now on the touchpad button (or space for PC users), meaning instant access to your wardrobe.

Check out the video above to see it in action!

[img]http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/Atom-Universe_20170821070545.jpg[/img] 

Change your outfit to match your mood or your destination. Show your allegiance to your friends by sporting the same cool accessory. Be the darling couple of AU by coordinating your date outfits. Compare your latest purchases, and show off your extensive collection. Like what you see? Buy it and put it on straight away! And best of all avoid that horrible moment when you realise you and someone else are wearing the same dress!

You can also change your gender and skin tone in this menu.

[img]http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/Atom-Universe_20170821070941.jpg[/img] 

Customise on the fly with our new player menu. So many creative possibilities now unlocked and available to you, wherever you are in Atom Universe!

We think this is pretty handy, and we hope you do too!




[h1]Would you like to see the menu?[/h1]


There are other improvements to the menus that we need to tell you about. Quite a bit has changed about the way you access many of the features, so spread the word and help people out if they get confused!

We have two menus in the game, one is called the Player Menu, and the other is the Action Menu.

Use the Action Menu if you want to pose, dance or change your emoji/flag. Press square (or Tab for PC users) and use the menu in the same way you have before. We have simplified this menu so that you can get to the section you want much quicker.

[img]http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/action-menu.jpg[/img] 

Use the Player Menu (press touchpad or space) to buy items, customise your avatar, access the social features, view your stickerbook or travel to other spaces.

[img]http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/player-menu-image.jpg[/img] 

If you were wondering about chat, it's still on triangle (or Alt for PC users), that hasn't changed.

At first it might take a little getting used to, but enjoy your new menus!




[h1]There's More to Explore in Aurora Private Islands[/h1]

[img]http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/aurora-scrapbook.png[/img]


Your own Private Aurora just got bigger! We have added a cluster of three new islands, providing more tranquil space, a picnic spot and a funky dancefloor! This new improved space also includes exclusive furniture items. Gather around the campfire, set out your beach furniture and watch the glorious fireworks decorate the beautiful night-time sky. Bring your friends to enjoy this wonderful space!

[img]http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/aurora-pi-furniture.png[/img]

It's a lovely surprise for those who supported us by buying Aurora Private Islands, thank you for your contribution to Atom Universe!




[h1]Spinning Around[/h1]

[img]http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/fidget.jpg[/img] 


We have a new toy for you to play with! Visit Arcade Plaza or The Hub and seek out the new fidget spinner game. Test your button-pressing prowess and set your fastest speed! Compete with other users by making it onto the global leaderboard! Or just use it to pass the time while you wait for your friends.




[h1]90s Dances[/h1]

[img]http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/90s-dances.png[/img]

Here comes another dance pack! This one contains 6 kitsch dances to throw you back to the 90s. You 'can't touch' it for it's retro feel. The pack comes with an iridescent version of the urban boots, which look super cool. There's some great party moves in there, so get the whole room involved, 'strike a pose' and 'jump on it'!



[h1]TOUCHDOWN!!![/h1]

[img]http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/American-football.jpg[/img]


The football season kicked off at the weekend with the start of the pre-season exhibition games. You might already have a favourite team, but how about supporting #TeamAtom by wearing our own football jersey? Available for Adam and Eve, you can customise the colours to create your 'away' strip too!

You can pair it up with these striped sweatpants for Adam when you are not out on the field, and here's a cute plain version of the pleated skirt for Eve; it's colour customisable so you can match it to your team's colours and become a punky cheerleader!




[h1]Travel 1st Class[/h1]


We have added Aurora and the Urban Apartment to the quick travel menu on the START tab. It's a handy way to get straight into game as quickly as possible and now you have more options to choose from.





[h1]Some other bits and bobs...[/h1]


[h1]It's Good to Stay Active[/h1]


This patch sees the introduction of an inactivity timer. If you do nothing for 1 hour you will see a message with a countdown. If you want to stay in the space you can cancel the message, and carry on as normal! If you don't cancel it, you will be whisked back to the main menu. 

Be aware- this will also happen if you are dancing, posing or have opened a menu and you are not doing anything else, like interacting with the menu or chatting for example. Moving around or interacting with the space will also reset the timer, so chances are you will never see the inactivity message, as you are all busy little bees!

We are doing this to make sure we don't have any pesky servers hanging around with one 'afk'(or absent) player inside. We want to make sure that our servers are lively spaces with a positive vibe, especially when new people arrive. Pitching up to an empty space with one non-responsive player in it is not the most welcoming experience!



[h1]All in Moderation...[/h1]


We have improved our moderation tools so that we can more effectively help people who are having an unpleasant time in the game. Now if we ban a player they will be removed from the space they are in, meaning the ban becomes effective immediately.

We have also added another element to the 'block' feature. Now if you block someone their Avatar will be hidden, as well as their chat. If they were bothering you by following you around...BLOCK and be gone :)

We have some other new tools available to us as well that we are not going to go into details about here, and also further plans to improve our reporting feature. So watch out trolls!



[h1]User Profile[/h1]


Have a look at your new User Profile which is available to view on the Settings tab of the main menu. Here you can see some details about your account, including your display name/ID, the date you created it, and the status- for example if you are currently banned that would appear here.
 





[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

	[*]Music from the video screens in Woodland House is now muted.[/*]

Improvements to items:
	[*]Crab Claw reward now moves with the hand.[/*]
	[*]Tracksuit bottoms no longer clip through long shirts.[/*]
	[*]Zip skirt is now properly colour customisable.[/*]


[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
	[*]Clothing/accessories sometimes do not display when you go to the Customise menu. Press refresh (touchpad or space) to reveal them.

notes.title: Dev Blog #67 - New Patch 0.8.0, collect those Gold orbs!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Atomians!

Woohoo! 0.8.0.4150 is here! It's time for another update :)

We can't wait to share the cool stuff with you, so here we go- time to unwrap the latest patch...
[h1]Gold Orbs have Arrived!![/h1]
[img]http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Atom-Universe_20170719121634.jpg[/img]

We've added a new challenge to Orb Runner so it's time to put your gold goggles into action!

Remember the gold orbs from the original Aurora? Well they've made it here to AU too...and they're still red :D
So it's time to start collecting these 50-point beasts.

If you own the gold goggles (what do you mean you haven't earned them yet? ;) ) the gold orbs will magically appear when playing Orb Runner. Then you can work towards the 'Strike Gold' challenges. There is something rather special as the reward for this so don't delay...see if you can be the first of your friends to win it!

If you don't own them yet, it's time you started collecting those silver orbs! To help you get cracking we decided to not charge you any atoms to play for another month! In future, Orb Runner will be like our other games which require our free in-game currency to play. So make the most of it- go play Orb Runner- RIGHT NOW :D
[h1]Smash the New Challenges![/h1]
[img]http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/WelcomeScreen_rewards.png[/img]

As well as the new Orb Runner challenge, we have even more challenges for you to play! We are so excited to announce that we have added three awesome challenges to our arcade game, Atom Smasher. We can't wait to see you earning your stickers and winning your rewards.
[h1]Spooky Time[/h1]
[img]http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/Costumes4-copy-1.png[/img]

Hot on the heels of the male skeleton costume last patch, we have added two new spooky costumes for Adam and Eve. If you feel like there's some haunting to be done, you can become a ghost; or if it's a little covert spying you need, then maybe the invisible character will do the trick.

You told us that Eve players wanted a skeleton of their own, so we are delighted to say we listened to your feedback and a female version is available now!

If you already purchased the male skeleton before the 0.8.0 patch came out, then keep an eye on your costumes tab for a nice little surprise!
[h1]Dance like no one's watching...[/h1]
[img]http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/dances-menu-copy.jpg[/img]

There's a cheeky new tab added to the Avatar menu called Dances & Poses. Here you can see all the dances and poses available in game and you can preview them to see how they look on your avatar. From this menu you can also purchase dance packs and check out the selection of poses and dances available for subscribers.
Ever wondered what that awesome dance was that you saw someone doing? Now you can do your research here!

If any of these mysterious new dances take your fancy, check out our subscription page for more information. While you're there you'll find there's a whole bunch of perks available for subscribers, not just extra dances and poses!

Have a look at our latest video and see if any of these funky moves catch your eye!

<iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/Ueca0sC-2XU" width="560" height="315" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen="allowfullscreen"></iframe>

What an awesome update! Have fun completing the new challenges and checking out the new spooky costumes!

That's all from me, see you next week!
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
	[*]Stability improvements, crashes/kicks should occur far less often[/*]
	[*]Orb Runner Silver Orbs now reward 25 points and are called 'Silver'[/*]
[/list]
[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
	[*]We have disabled some t-shirts while we improve stability - these will return once we have finished maintenance work on them[/*]
	[*]Orb Runner Gold Goggles will not appear as owned in the Orb Runner Menu as soon as you have completed the Tier 5 Silver Searcher challenge. Going back to the main menu will make them appear[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: DevBlog #53 - What's going to be in our upcoming update?
notes.notes:
Greetings,

Welcome to our latest edition of the Atom Republic DevBlog. This week, we’ll be taking a closer look at what’s going to be included our next update (v4.11.4132).  So, let’s get to the juicy information, shall we? 

[h1]Holo Horses is due to open![/h1] 

[img]http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/Edited-Screenshot.jpg[/img]

Our latest mini-game in the Arcade Plaza is opening for the first time. Known as Holo Horses, it’s time to take to the race track and place bets on your favourite horses. This will allow you to place Atoms on your chosen racer and if you’re lucky, you could win big!
 
Holo Horses will also introduce the first iteration of challenges. By completing these challenges, you’ll be able to unlock some pretty cool rewards for your avatar.

[h1]Atom Smasher is coming to the VIP Area[/h1] 

[img]http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/Edited-Screenshot2.jpg[/img]

The next instalment of our Arcade mini-games will soon be available to play in the VIP Area, located in the Arcade Plaza. Atom Smasher is a throwback to one of our favourite retro-style games where you are required to smash as many boxes as you possibly can before the boxes cross the line.  Collect power-ups, avoid the boxes containing the penalty powers and try to set the highest score for bragging rights.

[h1]Main Menu UI Revamp[/h1] 

[img]http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/Edited-Screenshot3.jpg[/img]

With the latest update, one the first things you might recognise is that our main menu has completely changed. No longer will you be required to travel from screen-to-screen looking to join public or private spaces, trying to find the avatar customisation screen or even trying to find the option. 

This new update will add a whole new level of simplicity to navigating our main menu. Now everything is accessible on one screen and you will allow you to navigate between different tabs by pressing the L1 & R1 buttons.
 
[h1]Easter Lost & Found Content[/h1] 

With Easter just around the corner, we’ll be putting a unique twist on the Lost & Found mini-game. From the next update, we’ll be replacing all the collectables with Easters Eggs. This will essentially make the Lost & Found mini-game become an Easter Egg Hunt, fun huh? 
 
[h1]New Animations[/h1] 

[img]http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/edited3.jpg[/img]

Premier members are going to gain three brand new animations to show off. Firstly, the Vulcan Salute pose is going to be available alongside with the Jumpstyle 4 and 5 dance animations. Secondly, the Facepalm pose will soon be available for free members of Atom Universe.
 
[h1]New Clothing[/h1] 

[img]http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/edited4.jpg[/img]

As a Premier Member, you will also be gaining some new items of clothing to your wardrobes. Male and Female avatars will have the stylish Varsity Jacket to wear.  Free members will also be able to find the seasonal Easter T-Shirts within their wardrobes. 

Male avatars will also be able to find a new casual looking shirt available in the Atom Universe Store.
 
Lastly, remember EmeraldPhoenix’s suggestions for Sandals? We’re happy to announce that these two suggestions are going to be making their appearance in the update.

[h1]New Accessories[/h1] 

Premier members are going to be able to wear a cute beany hat with bunny ears, whereas with free members can soon wear a bunny tail to help get into the Easter spirit. New accessories such as the Bunny Ears Headband and Gas Mask will also be on sale in the Atom Universe store.

[h1]New Hairstyles[/h1]  
In this update, a small handful of new hairstyles will also be added to the Atom Universe Stores for purchase. From the next update onwards you’ll be able to find the Pixie Hair, Wavy Mohawk, Short Bob and Long Ponytail. 

[h1]Disable UI[/h1] 

Following on from the revamp, our Designer has managed to find some time to begin disabling certain parts of the UI. This will allow you to turn off UI and gather screenshots of you and your friends, or maybe you would just like the remove chat boxes from the environment.

This is a first implementation of the disable UI and we’re aware that some elements of the UI will remain (such as interactions in the Cave House, or commands near the chairs and mini-games). We’re aiming to remove these from the UI within a future update. 

[h1]Inverted Y-Axis[/h1] 

The final mention in this week’s DevBlog is related to a much-asked feature from the Atom Universe Community and we’re happy to announce that the Inverted Y-Axis suggestion is going to be implemented into the upcoming update.  Once released, this setting can be activated/deactivated from the settings menu.

notes.title: DevBlog #48 – Upcoming changes and a new update coming today
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/JP2.jpg[/img]

We’re back! Now that 2017 is officially here, the Atom Republic team have returned to the studio and we’re kicking off another year of development by bringing you a new update to Atom Universe. However, that’s not all…our trusted DevBlog is also undergoing some changes in 2017! 

[h1]Upcoming changes to the DevBlog[/h1]

In 2017 we’ll be changing the frequency of our DevBlogs. Over 2016 we were releasing these posts on weekly basis, but after some careful consideration over 2017, we’ll be decreasing how often we share these posts. Instead of weekly updates, we’ll be delivering fortnightly updates with the aim of sharing more structured DevBlogs with you. 

 [h1]Patch v0.4.7.4131 goes live today on PlayStation 4 & Steam[/h1]

That’s right, our first update of the new year is getting released today! Premier members will be able to access our latest private space, the Japanese Garden.

 [img]http://www.atomrepublic.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/JP4.jpg[/img]

Take a step back and enjoy a tranquil and zen-like experience with the Japanese Garden. Sit back in your deck chair and enjoy the view or explore a minimalistic private space complete with Japanese architecture. 

[h1]Zombie Clothing now available to purchase [/h1]

A new line of clothing is now available within the user settings…Urrrrrgh! *Cough* You’ll now be able to purchase Zombie Clothing for Adam and Eve. The Zombie Clothing includes a top, pants shoes and eye lenses for both male and female. 

[h1]Wild dice have appeared in the Hub[/h1]

Some rather strange looking dice have appeared in the Hub, but what could they mean? Well, that’s completely up to you and your friends, can you think of any dice games you can play with other? 

[h1]Introducing the VIP Area[/h1]

Recently, we’ve been playing about with the idea of VIP areas in-game and we’ve implemented the first pass into the Arcade Plaza, if you’re a Premier member you will be able to enter this area and play an early access preview on the Arcade Machine, AquaVenger! We’d love to hear your feedback about this and how we can improve upon this idea! 

[h1]AquaVenger[/h1]

As part of the Early Access for Premier account, the AquaVenger will be available within the VIP area located in the Arcade Plaza. 

The AquaVenger features 5 challenging levels to play through featuring deadly enemies and even deadlier bosses. Can you set the highest score? 

[url=https://www.youtube.com/embed/wMwPO0Ei_SI]Click to view video[/url] 

[h1]Private Space Customization[/h1]

The first implementation of customizable private spaces is here. You’ll now be able to purchase the Atom Blaster arcade machine for your very own private space. It's time invite your friends around for games night! 

With this being the first implementation, we’re extremely interested to hear your feedback on how we can improve upon this feature. If you’ve got any suggestions, please do head over to our forums and post your feedback in the Feedback & Suggestion subforum. 

[h1]Patch Notes – v0.4.7.4132[/h1]

[list][*]AquaVenger arcade game now available in the VIP area located in the Arcade Plaza
[*]A strange set of dice have appeared in the Hub
[*]VIP area is now available for Premier members
[*]Japanese Garden is available for Premier members
[*]Zombie Clothing is now available in the User Settings menu
[*]Baseball Caps & Top hat are now available in the User Settings menu
[*]Additional Accessories are now available in the User Settings menu
[*]Purchase the Atomblaster arcade cabinet for the Mirage House, Woodlands House and Tree Top house private spaces
[*]Chat color has now been brightened
[*]Chat box no longer scrolls down when new messages are submitted
[*]Various bugs fixes

notes.title: DevBlog #35 – Early Access Release Dates & Premier Content Now Available
notes.notes:
Greetings,

Welcome this week’s DevBlog, it’s been quite an exciting week for us at the studio. Not only did details about the North & South American release come to light, but we’re all very happy to announce that Atom Universe will be rolling out in Australia from September 19th! If you haven’t had the chance so see our latest launch trailer, now’s the perfect time to check out.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b2aoPlMrL3Y

Well, the big question now…When is Atom Universe coming to Europe? While we haven’t got a date set in stone just yet, we can confirm that we’re focused on bringing to Atom Universe to Europe next. Keep an eye out on our social media channel for more future updates.

[h1]Increasing Server Capacity[/h1]

This weekend, we're going to increase our server capacity from 16 players to 32 players across PlayStation 4 & Steam. As part of a test, you're all invited to come and try to fill up our servers. If the test proves to be successful, we could potentially increase our server capacity to 32 players permanently.

notes.title: DevBlog #27 – New PlayStation 4 and Steam Early Access Update
notes.notes:
Greetings and welcome to this week’s Devblog. Today, we’re going to taking a closer look at Yesterday’s update for Early Access players.

[h1][u]Mirage House[/u][/h1][u]
[/u][url=https://www.facebook.com/SubD-Studio-530966900440259/]SubD Studio’s[/url] Mirage House makes its return to Atom Universe. Kickstarter backers will remember that the Mirage House was the first Private Space in Atom Universe. Now, this minimalist space has been completely reiterated.


[img]http://i.imgur.com/jcZYWbh.jpg[/img]


The first big change is the beautiful day and night cycle, now you’ll be able to sit by the pool and watch the sun set over the landscape. Kickstarter backers may also remember that the original Mirage House had two floors with enough space for seating and a bedroom. Now the newly design space is much bigger across one floor with additional seating areas and stylish fireplace.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/GKMeW7a.jpg[/img]

Outside, the swimming pool lights up at night illuminates the side on the property in crisp blue light. Behind the property, lights shine upon the palms trees, giving the landscape a warm glow.

[h1][u]Accessories[/u][/h1][u]
[/u]The avatar customization menu has received a lot more accessories in this new update. In fact, over 75 new accessories have added to help give your avatar a little bit more diversity.  Now your avatar will be able to wear a wide range of head accessories, wings, swords, shields and tails.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/SXynZRg.png[/img]

[h1][u]Performance Improvements[/u][/h1][u]
[/u]With this update comes some much needed performance improvements, most notably within the Hub. The Hub frame rate has now been increased and when you’re travelling around you’re less likely to come across those nasty frame rate drops.

notes.title: DevBlog #22 – Weekly Update & Developer Activity
notes.notes:
Why hello there, thank you for taking the time out to have a little read over this week’s DevBlog. Previously, we were talking about bringing the Woodlands House into Atom Universe and a couple of tasks the developers faced in doing so. 

This week, we've made some more advancements in bringing this new private space to fruition. Avatars can now explore the environment freely and interact with certain pieces of furniture. However, now that this is possible: how does the avatar travel to and from the Woodlands House?  

[img]http://i.imgur.com/u1RD0EY.jpg[/img]

The development team have been working on two ways that can allow you travel to the Woodlands House, the Hub and the Arcade Plaza. Firstly, you can do it the old fashioned way: select your desired destination via the main menu. That’s OK if you’ve just started the game, but what if you’re already in-game? 

Normally, in the Hub or the Arcade Plaza you could easily travel there by walking to the entrance, but it would be a bit different. The Woodland House is outside, it’s in the open, it’s peaceful and it’s away from the noise of the theme park. Having a doorway within the theme park itself, would break away from the immersion of the park and maybe even seem out of place. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/bQ8HkUb.jpg[/img]

Instead of forcing you back to the main menu and making you exist the game, the development team have now implemented the ability to fast travel between zones. Allowing to easily travel between Woodlands House, the Hub and the Arcade Plaza. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/jUYeyyB.jpg[/img]

While we’re getting closer to releasing this to everyone on Early Access, the main focus has now turned to bug hunting, although there isn’t a time frame as to when this update will be ready. We’re getting pretty close…

The development team have been working on two ways that can allow you travel to the Woodlands House, the Hub and the Arcade Plaza. Firstly, you can do it the old fashioned way: select your desired destination via the main menu. That’s OK if you’ve just started the game, but what if you’re already in-game? 

Normally, in the Hub or the Arcade Plaza you could easily travel there by walking to the entrance, but it would be a bit different. The Woodland House is outside, it’s in the open, it’s peaceful and it’s away from the noise of the theme park. Having a doorway within the theme park itself, would break away from the immersion of the park and maybe even seem out of place. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/bQ8HkUb.jpg[/img]

Instead of forcing you back to the main menu and making you exist the game, the development team have now implemented the ability to fast travel between zones. Allowing to easily travel between Woodlands House, the Hub and the Arcade Plaza. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/jUYeyyB.jpg[/img]

While we’re getting closer to releasing this to everyone on Early Access, the main focus has now turned to bug hunting, although there isn’t a time frame as to when this update will be ready. We’re getting pretty close…

Hello and welcome to issue #10 of the Atom Republic DevBlog. [url=http://atomrepublic.blogspot.co.uk/2016/03/devblog-9-whats-been-happening-over.html]In our last issue we we’re preparing the Arcade Plaza for our Alpha testers on Steam as well as making some smaller changes to the front end menu.[/url]

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/394120/][img]https://3.bp.blogspot.com/-DLVSjtfWhTg/VuL4akZQ8mI/AAAAAAAAAKQ/PBrI_alZdCcVoKzip0IzhI8g_uglGKtQA/s320/Steam-logo.png[/img][/url]
Since then, we've opened the doors of Atom Universe to the public on Steam Early Access and we’ve had an amazing response from the community who have been sharing their feedback across our social media channel and forums. 

Toward the beginning of this week, March 8th [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/394120/announcements/detail/842543095238880428]we release a Hotfix patch containing some bug fixes. You’ll be able to find more details here of what was included in the patch[/url].

[h1]What’s next?[/h1]
Firstly, our Community Team will be going over the forums and social media gathering any and all of your feedback and they’ll be relaying this information back along to the development team. Whether you've got an amazing suggestion for Atom Universe, or maybe there is a bug affecting you in-game. Make sure you either visit our forums on Steam, or on our Website and post away!


[h1]Working with the community[/h1]
With Steam Early Access available to the general public now, we’ll be looking at ways of how we can include the community (that’s you) in our development. From time to time, we’ll be posting polls that will allow you choose what features, mini-games or avatar clothing you’d like to see get implement next.

And who knows, maybe the Development team might like one of your suggestions and it could pop up in one of our polls further down the line.
